items.meaning: establishes and controls either a single or several time-synchronized streams of continuous media such as audio and video, and does not typically deliver the continuous streams itself
acts as a network remote control for multimedia servers
there is no notion of an RTSP connection
maintains a session labeled by an identifier
is in no way tied to a transport-level connection such as a TCP connection
may open and close many reliable transport connections to the server to issue RTSP requests
streams controlled by RTSP may use RTP
does not depend on the transport mechanism used to carry continuous media
the protocol is intentionally similar in syntax and operation to HTTP/1.1
extension mechanisms to HTTP can in most cases also be added to RTSP
客户端可以通过 HTTP 或其他方式请求表示描述（presentation description）。
媒体服务器可被“邀请”加入已有会议，以便向表示中播放媒体或录制媒体。

RTSP 请求可以像 HTTP/1.1 那样由代理、隧道和缓存处理。
